verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents read-status tracking (e.g., 'check which emails have been read' and shared 'Team Read Statuses'), confirming it can tell whether an email was opened, and community evidence (image/tracking-pixel comment) corroborates that read tracking is a real, functioning mechanism. However, none of the docs explicitly describe showing the exact timestamp of when a recipient opened an email — missing for 10: explicit 'opened at [time]' notification/timestamp feature, and independent hands-on confirmation of open-time accuracy.
